smell_validity.evidence: Verified in code: authorize grew 71 to 150 lines, handle_request 60 to 141, execute 9 to 169, update_function 39 to 109, the SAM generator 41 to 177; the whole suite passes unchanged. Entry methods now hand-code what adjacent, still-tested classes own - ARN formatting and wildcard regex beside intact LocalARNBuilder/ARNMatcher, request-event assembly beside LambdaEventConverter - so the lost orchestration-versus-implementation boundary, and its divergence cost, are unmistakable even unlabeled.

maintenance_impact.evidence: authorize duplicates the auth-context update at two depths and re-implements ARN and wildcard-matching rules that still live in tested classes, so future edits must keep copies in agreement or silently diverge; execute fuses per-type staleness rules with plan mutation. Extraction restores lasting responsibility boundaries, though the damage stays confined to these entry points rather than architecture-wide.

development_plausibility.evidence: Behavior is exactly preserved and house style fits: type comments, tone, hotfix-style renames, and helpers such as build_arn, ARNMatcher and create_lambda_event left production-dead yet test-alive. However all five bodies open with near-identical manifesto comments plus labeled stage regions, and the deliberate idiom rotations read as restructure-for-task, falling below indistinguishable organic drift.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: Matches the code exactly: it identifies all five bodies plus their collapsed stages, defines the finished state (one named method per pipeline step), and materially blocks costly misses - excludes cosmetic fixes and the one-dump-helper shortcut, forbids test edits, requires identical templates, and preserves deletion order including api-mapping placement, the sweeper's subtlest rule. Incomplete cleanup and irrelevant redesign are left almost no room.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Distinct decisions per stage: authorize mutates a shared event in place yet copies it shallowly for the authorizer event; policy matching translates wildcards; update_function must reuse the code-stage ARN for tags, bind its error context only around the code call, and preserve untag-before-tag plus waiter order; the sweeper extends lists versus appending names and front-inserts mappings; template regions guard on membership.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt names the areas and each holds one obviously giant method, so discovery is easy; the real burden is classifying scope: configuration-selected SAM versus Terraform generators share the `_generate_websocketapi` alias (the Terraform chain must stay excluded), the sweeper's getattr delete dispatch and specific_resources tuple must be reconciled with the inline staleness logic, and build_arn, create_lambda_event and ARNMatcher sit production-dead yet test-alive.

repair_coordination.evidence: Two rule sets interlock. In authorize, extracting helpers that copy instead of mutate lambda_event leaves handle_request forwarding an event missing requestContext.authorizer, and the shallow authorizer-event copy shares that dict. In update_function the tags stage depends on the code stage's returned FunctionArn and each stage keeps its own waiter check; the sweeper's list-versus-name staleness must match the planner's extend and front-insert rules.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: The best supported uniform operation - extract each stage-comment region verbatim, reconnecting surviving helpers - cleanly repairs update_function, the SAM generator and execute (three of five sites, roughly 60%), since their dict-building regions thread mechanically. The two local bodies instead force per-site control-flow choices, because route, unsupported-authorizer and preflight regions contain the method's own early returns.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Ordinary wrong edits hit exact-equality assertions: both waiter states, tag add/update/remove/no-op in stubbed call order, padding on both test JWT tokens, preflight headers, template resources and Outputs, and api-mapping insertion at instructions[0]. But no sweeper test covers kinesis or dynamodb staleness: deduplicating the four similar comparisons with a wrong marker name passes everything, silently orphaning or sweeping live event sources.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
